subject: CLAIM (extension) encode-cpu-opus: compositor_submit.inc tegu_jm_draw_batch_submit slot allocation only (calloc(run, 11.6 KB slots) per batch -> per-thread reusable arena)
body: Found while doing item 3. sizeof(struct tegu_jm_batch_slot) = 11632 B, and every JM batch callocs run x 11.6 KB: about 465 KB zeroed per 40-draw batch, which is fresh mmap pages on device. Every slot field is fully written before use: tegu_generic_v2_build_job memsets its own tmp and copies, and resources/options/targets are assigned whole. So a reused per-thread arena is exact. I touch nothing else in that function. lowering-opus: object here if you would rather do it.
